newsitem.title: USA: Kerr Group Inc Q4 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Kerr Group Inc Q4 oper loss.

text.p: Three Months and Twelve Months Ended December 31, 1996

NOTE: (A) The Company sold the manufacturing assets of its Consumer Products Business on March 15, 1996. The presentation of this business as discontinued operations had no effect on net loss, net loss applicable to common stockholders and net loss per common share from the amount previously reported.

1996 year includes $10.0 million pretax loss from restructuring costs, including relocation of corporate headquarters and wide mouth jar operations. In addition, the Company incurred a loss of $2,511,000 for restructuring costs primarily related to relocation of personnel and equipment.

1996 Q4 includes an unusual pretax loss of $575,000 for restructuring costs primarily related to relocation of personnel and equipment. The cost to complete the restructuring is expected to approximate the original estimate.

(D) Net earnings from discontinued operations includes an after-tax gain of $1,564,000 for the quarter ended March 31, 1996 and a subsequent adjustment to increase such after-tax gain by $538,000 during the quarter ended December 31, 1996. The increase in such gain was primarily related to a reduction in the reserve previously provided related to pension accounting. The gain on the sale of discontinued operations has been reduced by $4,900,000 of reserves consisting of i) severance pay, workers' compensation claims and insurance continuation costs of $1,400,000, ii) retiree health care and pension expenses of $1,200,000, iii) estimated net costs associated with elimination of operations and liquidation of working capital of $1,100,000, iv) professional fees of $700,000, v) asset retirements of $300,000, and v) other costs of $200,000.
(E) The Company has not declared a dividend on its Class B, Series D Preferred Stock since the first quarter of 1996.
